O método de Singapura trabalha com domín: The Singapore method works with mastery: you only move on when the current step is solid. At home, use this simple rule:
Avance para a próxima missão quando a cr: Move on to the next mission when your child can explain the drawing from the “draw the problem” stage on their own.
Se ainda não, refaça só essa etapa outro: If not yet, redo just that stage another day, with the numbers changed (each mission includes a suggestion on the adult page). Repeating with new numbers isn't falling behind: it's what makes the method work.

Acertar a conta sem conseguir explicar o: Getting the math right without being able to explain the drawing isn't mastery yet. Explaining the drawing and getting the math wrong from carelessness already is: just ask them to check.

8. Os 3 níveis e por onde começar: 8. The 3 levels and where to start
As 30 missões estão em 3 níveis de dific: The 30 missions are split into 3 difficulty levels, with 10 missions each. You choose where to start based on what your child can already do, not on age or grade.
Juntar, tirar, comparar, grupos iguais,: Putting together, taking away, comparing, equal groups, sharing, time, meters, and halves, thirds, and fourths. Numbers up to 100. The bar comes ready-made and your child just fills it in.

Problemas com 3 partes, “vezes mais”, fr: Problems with 3 parts, “times as many,” fractions of a quantity, division with remainders, kilograms and grams, liters, seconds, and graphs. Numbers up to 1,000. Your child splits the bar.
ele já resolve sozinho problemas de junt: they can already solve putting-together, taking-away, and comparing problems on their own.
Números com vírgula, proporção (achar 1: Decimals, proportion (find 1, then the total), before and after, sum and difference, fraction of what's left, unequal parts, simple percentages, perimeter, and area. Numbers up to 10,000. Your child draws on their own.

Na dúvida, comece pelo Nível 1: as prime: When in doubt, start with Level 1: the first missions are quick, and getting things right early on builds confidence. If it gets too easy, skip to that level's Final Mission. If they crack the code word and explain 3 of the 4 drawings, move up a level.
um mini-problema por dia, de 5 minutos,: one 5-minute mini-problem a day, to draw before solving. Challenges 1 to 10 go with Level 1, 11 to 20 with Level 2, and 21 to 30 with Level 3. Use them on days without a mission: before dinner, in the car, in the waiting room.
